run_rl_training: run the train function to start RLlib training with a specified algorithm and environment config
get_full_config: get the full environment config from a Hydra DictConfig with seedspath cleared
register_rl_env: register the RLlibNLE-v0 environment with Ray Tune using the RLLibNLEEnv wrapper
merge_algo_config: merge Hydra config with RLlib algorithm-specific defaults using merge_dicts for PPO, DQN, A2C, or IMPALA
setup_wandb_logging: setup Weights and Biases logging callbacks with project, entity, group, and tags for training runs
